items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: on the same order of the average Dixieland outfit, they were all very good, but I wouldn't say nothing too extraordinary.

ctx.x: Can you remember much about the Oliver band when they were here? Well they were pretty much
on the same order of the average Dixieland outfit, they were all very good, but I wouldn't say nothing too extraordinary.

I wondered about their reception, of course the people like myself are more or less a fanatic on the New Orleans style of music, and to me they were so wonderful, just to hear them on the record, what's left.
